authority.sourceOfTruth: This manifest declares the exact managed label set. Live GitHub labels are reconciled to it, never the reverse.
authority.acceptance: A label records an observable transition. No label expresses Owner acceptance.

categories.description: Lifecycle position of the packet. Exactly one per active Issue.
Named executor engagement lane. Exactly one per active Issue.
Whether the packet may author repository bytes. Exactly one per active Issue.
Category of bounded outcome. Exactly one per active Issue.
Program stage gate the packet belongs to, per PROGRAM-PLAN-v1.md. Exactly one per active Issue.
Primary exclusive lease domain held for the life of the packet. Exactly one per active Issue.

labels.name: state:ready
labels.description: Definition of Ready satisfied. Not dispatched. No worker running.

labels.name: state:dispatched
labels.description: Packet published. Dispatch alone changes no repository byte and starts no worker.

labels.name: state:active
labels.description: A worker posted STARTED evidence: real session, clone, branch, exact base.

labels.name: state:result
labels.description: Worker posted RESULT at an exact head with commands, changed paths, Draft PR, residual risk.

labels.name: state:review
labels.description: Non-author independent review requested or in progress at one exact head SHA.

labels.name: state:owner-gate
labels.description: Evidence assembled and pinned. Awaiting the Owner decision. Not an approval.

labels.name: state:blocked
labels.description: Fail-closed stop at an exact failed precondition. Completed work preserved.

labels.name: state:done
labels.description: Terminal. Merge or adoption verified from the authoritative surface and recorded.

labels.name: state:superseded
labels.description: Terminal. Replaced by a later packet, with the successor named in the closing comment.

labels.name: worker:opus
labels.description: Executor lane: one bounded Claude Code / Opus 5 terminal engagement.

labels.name: worker:codex
labels.description: Executor lane: one bounded Codex terminal engagement.

labels.name: worker:none
labels.description: No executor engagement. Coordination, decision preparation, or Owner-only work.

labels.name: mode:mutation
labels.description: Authors repository bytes. Requires exactly one branch and one Draft PR.

labels.name: mode:read-only
labels.description: Authors no repository byte. Holds no file or domain lease.

labels.name: kind:implementation
labels.description: Bounded product, platform, or pipeline implementation.

labels.name: kind:decision
labels.description: Decision preparation. Implements nothing and adopts nothing.

labels.name: kind:review
labels.description: Read-only non-author review pinned to one exact head SHA.

labels.name: kind:remediation
labels.description: Bounded closure of named blocking findings from a prior exact-head review.

labels.name: kind:infrastructure
labels.description: Governance, control-plane, or repository infrastructure. No product surface.

labels.name: kind:research
labels.description: Research Gate output. Zero authority until adopted in a decision record.

labels.name: gate:control-plane
labels.description: Coordination and control-plane infrastructure. Outside the numbered program stages.

labels.name: gate:g0
labels.description: Stage 0 — PROGRAM RESET.

labels.name: gate:g1
labels.description: Stage 1 — PRODUCT / EXPERIENCE DEFINITION.

labels.name: gate:g2a
labels.description: Stage 2A — VISUAL TARGET.

labels.name: gate:g2b
labels.description: Stage 2B — A600 MODEL / ASSET READINESS.

labels.name: gate:g2c
labels.description: Stage 2C — PLATFORM / QUALITY ARCHITECTURE.

labels.name: gate:g3
labels.description: Stage 3 — SHARED ENGINEERING FOUNDATION.

labels.name: gate:g4
labels.description: Stage 4 — DETERMINISTIC A600 ASSET PIPELINE.

labels.name: gate:g5
labels.description: Stage 5 — PRODUCT VERTICALS.

labels.name: gate:g6
labels.description: Stage 6 — RELEASE 1.

labels.name: gate:later
labels.description: Stage 7 or later. Not open. Not dispatchable at the current stage.

labels.name: domain:governance
labels.description: Primary lease: governance records outside governance/control-plane.

labels.name: domain:github-control-plane
labels.description: Primary lease: .github, governance/control-plane, tools/control-plane.

labels.name: domain:product-definition
labels.description: Primary lease: product and experience definition records.

labels.name: domain:visual-target
labels.description: Primary lease: visual target contract and reference surfaces.

labels.name: domain:asset-readiness
labels.description: Primary lease: A600 model and asset readiness surfaces.

labels.name: domain:platform-quality
labels.description: Primary lease: platform and quality architecture surfaces.

labels.name: domain:engineering-foundation
labels.description: Primary lease: shared engineering foundation, tokens, layout, and navigation.

labels.name: domain:a600-pipeline
labels.description: Primary lease: deterministic A600 asset pipeline surfaces.

labels.name: domain:product-vertical
labels.description: Primary lease: one product vertical surface.

labels.name: domain:release
labels.description: Primary lease: Release 1 integration and release surfaces.

labels.name: domain:reception
labels.description: Primary lease: reception and memory surfaces.

labels.name: domain:catalog
labels.description: Primary lease: catalog expansion surfaces.
